canonical_statement: Provisional scope claim: in a fixed Lorentzian differential-geometric convention and unit system, the Einstein field equation is G_ab + Lambda g_ab = kappa T_ab, where G_ab = Ric_ab - (1/2) R g_ab; an exact theorem proposition remains to be selected.
domain_and_universes: Not frozen: expected objects include a smooth four-dimensional Lorentzian manifold, a metric g, curvature tensors derived from g, a symmetric stress-energy tensor T, and scalar constants Lambda and kappa.
quantifiers: for every spacetime and tensor data satisfying the definitions and convention profile selected by the statement phase
pointwise for all tangent vectors or tensor indices, depending on the selected encoding
hypotheses: metric regularity sufficient to define Ricci and scalar curvature
fixed dimension, signature, curvature-sign, units, and tensor-index conventions
any physical assumptions on T must be stated rather than inferred
conclusion: Unresolved: likely a checked equivalence between expanded Ricci/scalar-curvature notation and Einstein-tensor notation, or a precisely scoped consequence of the field equation; the equation itself is model data, not a proved conclusion.

alternate_encodings.target: Ric - (1/2) R g + Lambda g = kappa T
alternate_encodings.relationship: definitionally or propositionally equivalent after defining the Einstein tensor
four-dimensional vacuum, Lambda = 0 consequence/equivalent form subject to trace and convention assumptions

excluded_cases_and_neighboring_claims: THM-M-1311 local Cauchy existence for the Einstein equations
stability, singularity, conservation, matter-field evolution, and experimental-confirmation claims
vacuum or Lambda = 0 variants as replacements for the general equation
foundation_profile: Not instantiated; classical logic, manifolds, tensor bundles, quotients, and choice dependencies require audit.

computation_profile: No numerical relativity computation, external solver, automation result, or oracle is credited.

freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on changes to the equation regime, conventions, canonical proposition, Lean target, toolchain/imports, source pins, or rev-5.6 standard.
